title: Posting Retry
description: posting-retry/v2: the pledger answering the exception on a failed posting by moving the line again, once what failed it is fixed (the source account funded, a ledger back). The event cites the exception, which resolves it; the next posting of the line is the new movement, and if that fails too a new exception follows.

tradeId.description: The trade whose line is moved again.

exceptionId.description: The exception event the retry answers, as the event cites it.

reportId.description: The trade's initial margin call, the reportId of its im-report, which the line answers, so a reader can group the retry with the trade's movements.

reason.description: What changed since the movement failed, in the pledger's own words.
